title: Will OpenAI release Astra 6.1 before Oct 23, 2026?
rules: If OpenAI releases Astra 6.1 before Oct 23, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: Release must be to the public, outside of a closed beta, though limiting it to a high-cost subscription tier is acceptable.

blind.reasoning: OpenAI had planned GPT-6.1 Astra for an October 2026 launch but publicly cancelled it on Sept 29, 2026 after it failed internal safety and alignment testing. It shipped GPT-6.1 Sol instead. Reversing that decision, fixing the model and releasing it publicly in the roughly 10 days before Oct 23 would be highly unusual.
blind.falsifier: OpenAI publicly releases a model named GPT-6.1 Astra (in ChatGPT or the API, outside a closed beta) on or before Oct 22, 2026.

final.reasoning: OpenAI publicly cancelled GPT-6.1 Astra on Sept 29 for safety reasons and filled the 6.1 slot with GPT-6.1 Sol. A public release before Oct 23 would require an unusually fast reversal. I raised my estimate slightly because the 20% price may reflect recent news I couldn't check, but it still looks too high.
